shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, ledger-aware island logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view only).
- Selection survives column view switches. Pocket maps: celestial/climate via GROUND map; fog-mesh self-heal on first view. Underground biome trial notes in pass 16.
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- Logistics doctrine: storage priority wins; consumers fetch back per need; demand hauls residual-clamped + ledger-aware; ALL carried-cargo continuations target the LANDED thing (merge-safe).

## REMOVED FEATURES (postmortems preserved)
**SKYLIGHTS (round 7)** — postmortem pass 16. **MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12)** — removed per user; revisit dossier: 1.6 water facts (riverFlowMap per-variant optional, riverGraph never scribed; wide rivers = IsRiver core + still fringe; width>20 strips roof), three-signal detection (thick-roof tunnel / canyon flanks / mountain-closeness) all implemented at removal, per-FACE hydrology spec (upstream apron, downstream lift + falls, full-body seal), working machinery (ExecuteLift, per-stretch verdicts, BFS apron, force-lift tool); UNSOLVED: per-stretch single-exit-face lip resolution + braided-terrain seal. Lessons in lore (biomes).

## VERIFIED
RMB cross-level (USER) · basement (USER) · Batch A (USER) · bug-wave fixes "mostly fixed" (USER): mech charge crash gone, bill supply + mech RMB working.

## RECENT FIX HISTORY (passes 23-25)
- Pass 23: `Invoke(null)` on instance ShouldAutoRecharge → Logistics guard tripped per session. Fixed + demand fan-cap + forbidden-aware availability + mech RMB orders.
- Pass 24: ferry discipline — in-flight ledger, residual clamps, onward demand hop.
- Pass 25: merge-kill fix (continuations target LANDED thing; mechs included) + bill-product cross-level continuation.

# VANILLA PARITY SCAFFOLD (pass 26 deep scan; P0 BUILT pass 27)

## Audit baseline (do not rebuild)
Work migration core (idle + better-work probes + plausibility cache + emergency scans + robot variant) · full ferry stack · needs bridges (rest/food/joy/meditation/gear/medical/gatherings/rituals/pens) · areas column semantics · resource counter/wealth/IsPlayerHome/bonds/colonist bar/trade/caravans/power/pipes/weather · threats suite · mech suite · animal flows.

## P0 — UI TRUTH ✅ BUILT (pass 27)
1. **Bill skill warning** ✅ — single-sink prefix on `Bill.CreateNoPawnsWithSkillDialog` (BillScopePatches.cs): suppressed when ANY free colonist in the viewed column satisfies the recipe's skill requirements; covers both ITab_Bills and HealthCardUtility callers (dialog is informational — the bill is added either way, so suppression is complete). KNOWN LIMITATION (deferred): the sibling "RecipeRequiresMechanitor" dialog in ITab_Bills lives in a compiler-generated lambda (map-scoped mechanitor check) — rare edge (gestation bills w/ mechanitor on another level), not patched.
2. **Bill pawn-restriction dropdown** ✅ AUDITED CLEAN — vanilla uses `PawnsFinder.AllMaps_FreeColonists` (game-wide); no patch.
3. **Building-existence alerts** ✅ — column-union postfixes in AlertPatches.cs: Alert_NeedMealSource (any meal source in column), Alert_NeedDefenses (rooftop turrets/basement traps count), Alert_NeedJoySources (TRUE union of joy kinds across column vs ground expectation, via JoyKindsOnMapTempList). Alert_NeedResearchBench ✅ AUDITED CLEAN (iterates all maps).
4. **Fire visibility** ✅ AUDITED CLEAN — Alert_FireInHomeArea iterates all maps with no home gate, and levels carry their own mirrored Home areas → basement fires already alert. (Firefighter PULL cadence remains P1 #7.)

## P1 — EMERGENCY RESPONSIVENESS (next up)
6. Tend/doctor pull (patient needing tend/surgery on level X pulls capable doctor from level Y via emergency scan). 7. Firefighting pull (home-area fire on linked level = emergency migration trigger). 8. Feed-patient/warden-feed pull. 9. Flick designations bump the work version (instant probe re-arm).

## P2 — NEEDS COMPLETENESS
10. Scheduled drugs bridge. 11. Patient self-bedding (FindPatientBedFor hospital variant). 12. Deathrest casket audit (Biotech).

## P3 — DLC DOERS
13. Anomaly entity transport to platforms (capture-shaped bridge). 14. Children learning/school (Biotech). 15. Throne/Reign (Royalty). 16. Mech repair/gestation verify. 17. Anima linking audit.

## P4 — VERIFY-ONLY (test session, build only if red)
18. Crafter bench pull · 19. research · 20. refuel doer · 21. warden flows · 22. corpse→grave ferry · 23. snow · 24. taming/training/milking/shearing · 25. plant work/blight · 26. repair/deconstruct/smooth · 27. prisoner escape routing.

## OPEN QUESTIONS / OPTIONAL
Animal area-driven migration (user to arbitrate) · guard-trip LETTER · cross-level "take to specific storage" for bills · level-suffixed storage-group names.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky + basement (starter stairs) · AB: basement diagnostic · AB: light diagnostic · AB: RMB diagnostic.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE
0. Round-2 ferry verification (crafter continuation, merge-case arrivals, no stair-top piles, mech arrivals) + **P0 verification: add a high-skill bill with the only qualified crafter on another level (no dialog); stove/defenses/rec room on another level (no false alerts)**.
1. Below-level lighting. 2. Animal flow + direct-to-blueprint. 3. BAM/Batch B/C compat. 4. Perf smoke, CE-absent, translation audit, soak, publishing. 5. P4 verify-only sweep.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 (VERIFIED, mech-inclusive) · basement (VERIFIED) · haul/ferry stack (ledger+clamps+onward+merge-safe+bill continuation) · below-level lighting · animal flows · mech charge (VERIFIED) · demand fixes · **P0 UI truth (skill warning + 3 column alerts; 3 audited clean)** · BAM compat · perf pass · Batch A verified · Batch B/C pending. REMOVED: skylights, mountain rivers.

## Compat

Robots/++ · Hauler's Dream+PUAH · Allow Tool · Ancient urban ruins · CE · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded · WVC: virtual-dispatch safe.

## Status
2026-07-25 (27th pass): **P0 UI-truth batch built green — bill skill warning column-scoped (single-sink), meal/defense/joy alerts column-union; research bench, fire visibility, and restriction dropdown audited already-correct.** Next: P1 emergency responsiveness. Pending verification: round-2 ferry fixes + P0.
